title: Whole-book scoped admission and execution costs
question: What delays native scoped admission on the largest retained book views, and which failures must be resolved before contextual replay?
method: Use only the first scoped batch on the sealed Standard source during diagnosis. Compare the exact Python and native reading populations from retained annotation task 1347. Sample the active Python stack and PostgreSQL statement, and retain the relevant run and validator dispositions.

conclusion: Reusing prepared native anchor indexes shortened report construction. Reconstructing predicate layout, text and negation at block scope let view 167 reach named-link admission within the existing database deadline. Run 316 hit that deadline in named-link candidate reconstruction. The remaining scoped batches and contextual replay stayed unscheduled.
